execution.objective: Port the approved monthly hygiene process to mainline using only the bounded paths approved for planning in WCS-028.

cleanup_policy.age: Never recommend or delete artifacts 90 days old or newer.
cleanup_policy.approval_model: The approved recurring WCS applies to the eligible list as a whole.

success_criteria: Port only the enumerated hygiene and governance paths from WCS-028; do not import unrelated source-branch history.
Rebind the work-cycle authority to the mainline baseline and record valid checksum evidence.
Preserve the production exclusion and strict greater-than-90-day rule; unknown evidence fails closed.
Ensure a dated candidate register is produced before any scheduled deletion and every deletion is recorded.
Keep manual workflow dispatch in dry-run mode; scheduled cleanup may run only under the approved policy after the workflow reaches mainline.
Do not execute cleanup during implementation or validation.
Do not modify application runtime, Builder behavior, packages, databases, Supabase, or deployment configuration.

depends_on: REP-STEWARD-027-WCS-001 Approved Monthly Hygiene Review and Cleanup
unlocks: Mainline activation of the monthly scheduled process after this implementation WCS is approved, verified, and merged.

forbidden_surface: Files outside the WCS-028 approved port-path list, except the new WCS-029 authority records
Candidates with unknown or unverifiable eligibility evidence
Application runtime, Builder behavior, packages, database, Supabase, and deployment changes
Cleanup execution during implementation or validation

founder_runtime_test.test_definition: Validate port scope and policy without activating the schedule or deleting files.
founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: A draft implementation WCS is staged for founder review.
